paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 99b: Rabbi Ami would send cases to him because he ruled permissively, in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, on the ground that sinews do not impart flavor.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The separately read Davidson 99b paragraph explicitly has רבי אמי sending to רבי יצחק בן חלוב, ruling permissively משום רבי יהושע בן לוי. This supports Rabbi Ami and the Yehoshua ben Levi initials expansion. Supplied הלוב/bar differs from named חלוב/ben; the heading remains Halov with R', rather than importing a full title across an unresolved patronymic spelling difference.

Sinews-do-not-impart-flavor is the negated ruling; the named paragraph also gives it as final halakhah. Hyman’s parenthetical may summarize that ruling, without proving whether it was his own gloss. Cases is a contextual English object; the sender/ruler direction is supported by the exact episode. צט: gives 99b; digital evidence is not printed repair history.
